claims.statement: Joe Coburn offered to back Mike McCoole against Tom Allen in a 24-foot prize ring under the latest London rules, for $5,000 to $10,000, anywhere in the United States, to be fought within sixty days of signing.
claims.excerpt: I bereby offer to back Mike McCoole against Tom Allen, ina fight in a twert:-four foot prize ring,

notes: Signed manifesto printed from a Nevada paper; the date of the offer is not given. 'twert:-four' is read as 24-foot.
